data.desc: Comtech is transitioning to a focused communications technology company with deep expertise in public safety and mobile networks and a unique command of where they intersect. Through its Allerium segment, Comtech provides infrastructure and software that help locate, route, deliver, answer and coordinate 9-1-1 and emergency communications, while providing mobile network operators with carrier-grade location, messaging and public alerting capabilities. Together, these capabilities connect people, devices and critical information when every connection counts.
